# EnergyGrid Drive upload boundary (inactive)

- Loopback webhook with its own Header Auth; separate from the email workflow and never reaches SMTP.
- Modes: RESERVE_ID (files.generateIds, creates nothing), RECONCILE (read-only), UPLOAD_IF_ABSENT, RESOLVE_DESTINATION (read-only).
- Every create uses the core's frozen pre-generated file ID. A same-ID create answered 409 is read back, never re-minted.
- Upload happens only when the reserved ID is absent and both complete conflict searches are empty. No overwrite, suffix or delete.
- The core alone decides success from the raw read-back; an HTTP 200 is never success. No retries, no saved execution data.

## Required manual configuration:

- **EnergyGrid Drive Webhook**
  - `Path`: replace REPLACE_WITH_DRIVE_WEBHOOK_PATH with the private loopback path in an authorised import copy.
